serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) Collaboration, formerly the Vyopta Platform, is now part of HP Inc’s portfolio of technology solutions. WXP Collaboration provides monitoring and analytics for collaboration and unified communication technology. It’s suite of applications delivers single-pane-of-glass, enterprise-wide visibility, and insights across multi-vendor collaboration environments to improve IT efficiency, increase end user productivity, and accelerate workplace transformation and technology migrations.
